# TPC-DS Q79 — Store Sales Customer/Store Profit

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Reports customer profit by store for specific household demographics

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUBSTRING(s_city FROM 1 FOR 30), ss_ticket_number, amt, profit FROM (SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, store.s_city, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS amt, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit FROM store_sales, date_dim, store, household_demographics WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk AND store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk AND (household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 8 OR household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0) AND date_dim.d_dow = 1 AND date_dim.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1, 1998 + 2) AND store.s_number_employees BETWEEN 200 AND 295 GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, ss_addr_sk, store.s_city) AS ms, customer WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, SUBSTRING(s_city FROM 1 FOR 30), profit LIMIT 100
```
